options: A study using obstructions that created medium-sized vortices in low-visibility conditions found that the wider-headed anglerfish (Lophiodes monodi) bumped into obstructions more often than the narrower-headed Lobocheilos rhabdoura did. 正确选项 86% 选择

In a 2023 study, archaeologists tested the red pigment on decorated beads made by members of the Natufian culture approximately 15,000 years ago.
